aiMetadata.description: Records a custom behavioral event (by event name) for a specific player in Gameball, identified by their player unique ID, so it can drive loyalty/gamification rules. Use when an agent needs to log that a player performed an action. Not idempotent: each call posts the event again, so repeats register as additional occurrences.
